From finding to next step.

Nemotron drafts suggestions from verified changes. You review the plan; no code is executed.

Focused checks. Visible limits.

We check removed operations, newly required inline parameters or request bodies, and removed success response codes.

We do not resolve references, compare full schemas, check authentication or test runtime behavior. No detected changes does not prove compatibility.

AI reference validation does not guarantee correct advice. Review every suggested step. Only change descriptions are sent to Nebius when you explicitly request a plan.
